name: open_screen
description: Take the patient to a screen in the app: home, chat, medicines, calls (their check-in calls), memory (what you remember about them) or profile. Use it instead of describing where to tap.

name: open_item
description: Open one of the patient's medicines so they can see its dose times and supply. Name the medicine as it appears on the Medicines screen.

item.description: The medicine's name or id, e.g. "Metformin 500 mg" or "metformin".

name: mark_done
description: Record that the patient has taken today's dose of one of their medicines. Only when the patient says they have taken it; never assume.

item.description: The medicine's name or id, e.g. "Metformin 500 mg" or "metformin".
